title: Little dragon waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ee85e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2ea82e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bellyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f5f5dc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4cfa0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='38' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#80d880' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-20 28 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='38' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#80d880' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(20 72 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='40' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#a0e8a0' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-20 30 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='40' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#a0e8a0' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(20 70 40)'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='26' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='13' ry='17' fill='url(#bellyGrad)'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 85 Q50 95 62 92 Q70 90 68 84 Q66 80 60 82 Q54 84 50 85 Z' fill='#2ea82e'/>
  <path d='M62 92 L66 98 L70 92 Z' fill='#ff6b3d'/>

  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q22 62 20 70' stroke='#2ea82e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='70' r='4' fill='#3bc83b'/>

  <!-- right arm (waving up) -->
  <path d='M70 55 Q80 48 82 38' stroke='#2ea82e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#3bc83b'/>
  <!-- fingers waving -->
  <line x1='82' y1='34' x2='85' y2='29' stroke='#3bc83b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='84' y1='37' x2='88' y2='34' stroke='#3bc83b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='79' y1='35' x2='80' y2='30' stroke='#3bc83b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='88' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2ea82e'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='88' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2ea82e'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='90' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6b3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='90' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6b3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='90' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6b3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='90' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6b3d'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='18' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#3bc83b'/>

  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#1a6e1a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#1a6e1a'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='33' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='33' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#1a3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#1a3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='33' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M38 20 Q36 12 32 8 Q38 12 42 19 Z' fill='#ffcc44'/>
  <path d='M62 20 Q64 12 68 8 Q62 12 58 19 Z' fill='#ffcc44'/>

  <!-- ear frills -->
  <path d='M32 30 Q24 26 20 30 Q26 30 30 34 Z' fill='#ff6b3d'/>
  <path d='M68 30 Q76 26 80 30 Q74 30 70 34 Z' fill='#ff6b3d'/>

  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M50 18 L54 24 L50 24 Z' fill='#ffcc44'/>
  <path d='M42 22 L44 28 L40 27 Z' fill='#ffcc44'/>
  <path d='M58 22 L56 28 L60 27 Z' fill='#ffcc44'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 53 56 48' stroke='#1a6e1a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ff8899' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ff8899' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
